title: Single hieratic sign, Berlin, Ägyptisches Museum und Papyrussammlung, P 3055 (AKU HT 65880)

object.name: Berlin, Ägyptisches Museum und Papyrussammlung, P 3055

source.attribution: Georg Möller, Hieratische Paläographie, retro-digitised by AKU-PAL (Akademie der Wissenschaften und der Literatur Mainz), AKU Hieratogramm 65880

notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 65880; AKU grapheme G0530 (AKU GR 271). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: G39 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 216, 216B. Source publication of this facsimile: Möller 1936a. Occurrence: line 6; find place Theben; writing direction "Zeilen, linksläufig prograd"; sign size 13.4 x 18.2 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Dritte Zwischenzeit, 22.–23. Dynastie". Facsimile type: Retro-Digitalisat (Publikation), by Georg Möller. Source scan (WEBP) converted to PNG at native resolution, flattened onto white, white margin added.
